## 📝 Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link the related issue where applicable.

## 🎯 Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or content improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Accessibility or responsive improvement
- [ ] Build, CI or maintenance
- [ ] Security

## 🔍 Implementation details

Explain the files changed, relevant design decisions, and any trade-offs. Call out any change to external resources, dependencies, public claims, or data collection.

## 🧪 Verification

- [ ] Ran `npm ci` if dependencies changed
- [ ] Ran `node --check main.js` if JavaScript changed
- [ ] Served `docs/` locally and tested navigation
- [ ] Tested consultation and education panels where relevant
- [ ] Checked responsive layout and keyboard access
- [ ] Checked local images, stylesheets, fonts and links
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and Mermaid diagrams
- [ ] Did not submit real contact information
- [ ] Did not claim an unimplemented backend/API/database capability

## ♿ Accessibility

Describe keyboard, focus, semantic HTML, contrast, and screen-reader considerations. If not applicable, explain why.

## 🔐 Security and privacy

- [ ] No secrets or private contact data are included
- [ ] Form endpoint and external resources were reviewed
- [ ] No untrusted content is inserted as executable HTML
- [ ] Workflow permissions and dependencies were reviewed when changed

## 📷 Evidence

Add genuine screenshots for visible changes. Do not fabricate product states or metrics.

## ✅ Final checklist

- [ ] Existing files and assets are preserved unless removal was explicitly approved
- [ ] No unrelated application code was changed
- [ ] README and docs remain accurate
- [ ] Known limitations are recorded
